name: Delta Electronics Manufacturing Corporation
old_description: Our updated platform offers streamlined access to RF designs across nearly 100 interfaces. We will consistently add new products, so check back often for the latest design resources.
about:
Delta Electronics Manufacturing Corporation operates from Beverly, Massachusetts. The company traces its roots back over 65 years, having evolved from a small manufacturing business into a global provider of RF, microwave, and millimeter-wave solutions. No founding year or founder names are disclosed, and ownership structure is not specified.

Delta designs and manufactures RF connectors, adapters, and cable assemblies across nearly 100 interface types, covering frequencies from DC to 67.5 GHz for connectors and 13.56 MHz to 65 GHz for cables. Its Advanced Vertically Integrated (AVI) facilities handle the full production chain in-house: design and simulation, precision machining, soldering, plating, assembly, and testing — including insertion loss, return loss, phase, and delay verification. The company also produces semi-rigid and flexible cable equivalents, high-power cables, high-frequency test cables, and accessories such as keying baskets, dust caps, and custom hardware.

Delta serves military, aerospace, communications, broadcast and audio, test and measurement, and semiconductor industries. As a longtime QPL supplier qualified to MIL-PRF-55339, it provides interconnects for military aircraft, satellite launch vehicles, and missiles. Aerospace programs use its components in commercial aircraft, drones, and satellites. Communications customers include two-way radio, base station, and antenna system manufacturers. Broadcast and audio applications span in-ear monitors, broadcast infrastructure, and alert systems. Test and measurement clients range from semiconductor chip makers to RF calibration labs. In the semiconductor sector, Delta's interconnects appear in etch equipment, deposition tools, and chip testers.

The company emphasizes its "Delta Difference" — vertically integrated facilities that control the entire manufacturing process from raw stock to finished product, enabling quick, cost-effective delivery of high-performance customized solutions. Reliability, durability, and performance are cited as the drivers behind this integration.
